eventDetail.scope: ETAI 2027 provides an international forum for research and innovation in intelligent systems, electronic information technologies, and artificial intelligence. The conference welcomes studies on computational intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, fuzzy systems, computer vision, signal and image processing, intelligent control, robotics, and autonomous systems. Particular attention is given to the integration of intelligent methods with sensing, information processing, decision making, optimization, and system modeling. Contributions addressing human machine interaction, cyber physical systems, intelligent manufacturing, smart transportation, and other emerging intelligent applications are also encouraged. The conference aims to promote advances in intelligent technologies and their integration into complex systems and practical applications.
